what: CNA Financial writes commercial property and casualty insurance in the United States: liability, workers' compensation, professional and management liability, and some specialty lines. It is majority owned by Loews.
customers: Businesses of all sizes buying commercial cover through independent agents and brokers.
money: professional liability, management liability and surety
moat: Long-standing agent relationships and a reserve base built over a century of writing liability business, which newer insurers cannot price as confidently.
risks: Old asbestos and environmental liabilities are reinsured but not entirely gone
Only one analyst covers the stock, which means little attention and thin liquidity
Commercial insurance pricing has been softening after several strong years
opportunities: 12.6 times earnings and 5.9 times free cash flow with $2.2B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $11.9B to $15.0B in four years
Higher bond yields mean the investment portfolio earns more than it has in a decade
watch: The combined ratio and net investment income.
